project_type: Python FastAPI backend with React frontend, Cloudflare Edge, MongoDB Atlas, Upstash Redis
build_system: pip with requirements.in -> requirements.txt (pip-compile), Docker for deployment
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, httpx AsyncClient via ASGITransport in tests/conftest.py
build_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in && python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")'
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to confirm no import errors or test regressions. 2. Validate all new router modules can be imported. 3. Check that main.py registers all new routers without error.
setup_instructions: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in (or use Docker: docker build -t syrabit-backend .)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - can install packages and pull images. No live MongoDB/Redis available in sandbox so tests must mock DB calls. The conftest.py uses ASGITransport with the real FastAPI app object.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify the content generation workflow (RAG pipeline, chat endpoint, embedder, search service). Only create admin endpoints to VIEW and MANAGE content metadata.
key_patterns: FastAPI routers in app/api/v1/. Models use Beanie ODM (Document subclasses). Auth via _validate_admin_session(request) reading httpOnly cookie. CSRF check via _csrf_check(request) on mutating endpoints. Settings via app.config.settings singleton. Redis via app.db.redis.get_redis(). MongoDB client via app.db.mongo.get_mongo_client(). Each router file exports a `router = APIRouter()`. Registration in main.py via app.include_router().
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - API routers. apps/backend/app/models/ - Beanie ODM models (User, Chat, ChatFeedback). apps/backend/app/db/ - Database connections (mongo.py, redis.py). apps/backend/app/services/ - AI, search, payment, comms services. apps/backend/app/config.py - Pydantic Settings. apps/backend/tests/ - pytest tests with conftest.py fixtures.
